description: Java source file defining a REST API resource for self share products in the Apache Fineract project. It exposes endpoints for retrieving specific share products and listing all available share products accessible to a client.

classes.name: SelfShareProductsApiResource
classes.description: A REST resource class providing endpoints to retrieve self share products, integrated with dependency injection, API annotations, and conditional activation.

methods.name: retrieveProduct
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific share product by product ID for a client, validating client mappings before delegating to the products API resource.

methods.name: retrieveAllProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all share products with pagination support, validating client mappings before delegating to the products API resource.
